description: DVWDesign canonical Renovate preset for PUBLIC repos — mirrors RootDispatcher/config/renovate-base.json (the private-repo source of truth), whose description carries the full rationale. Consume via: "extends": ["github>DESIGN-DVW/renovate-config"]. Kept in sync by hand — see DISPATCH-094; this file is now IDENTICAL to the private preset except for this description. MERGE POLICY v3.0: a narrow SAFE CLASS automerges via GitHub native auto-merge; everything else is a reviewed PR. PREREQUISITE: every consumer of this preset must require a CI check on its default branch (CiCheck ruleset, repo property ci-required=true) — DocuMind does since 2026-11-11. CADENCE: Wednesday whole day, 7-day release age; shared-packages runs every other day at 3 days and adopts first.

packageRules.description: Internal @design-dvw/* are private GitHub Packages governed by the shared-packages release + consumer-registry flow (shared-packages-first) — NOT by Renovate. Disabling avoids private-registry 'no-result' lookup failures (the Renovate bot has no read:packages auth). Security of these packages is managed at the shared-packages source; see DEPENDENCY-GOVERNANCE.md › Internal packages.

Group all Storybook packages so they move together in ONE PR (they must stay on the same version). Storybook version alignment follows shared-packages (Main) — see docs/ecosystem/DEPENDENCY-GOVERNANCE.md.

FLOOR: nothing automerges unless a later rule explicitly allows it. Ordered before the safe-class allowances so those win, and before the final never-automerge rule so that one wins over everything. Overrides any automerge inherited from config:recommended.

SAFE CLASS (class B, PR-classes brief 2026-11-09): devDependencies patch+minor automerge. Dev tooling cannot reach a production artifact, and the required CI check is the gate. Needs a required status check on the default branch (DISPATCH-140) or GitHub merges untested.
SAFE CLASS: @types/* non-major automerge. Type-only, compile-time; a break shows up as a failing typecheck in CI, not at runtime.

SAFE CLASS (class A, mechanical): lockfile maintenance, range pinning and GitHub Action digest re-pins. No declared version changes; pinning and digest re-pinning strictly reduce supply-chain surface (see helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests above).
Major version bumps are additionally labelled so the watchdog and reviewers can triage them first (human-gated per DECISION-RIGHTS.md)
NEVER AUTOMERGE: production runtime dependencies, any update type. Explicit rather than implicit, so loosening a rule above cannot accidentally open this lane.

NEVER AUTOMERGE, whatever a rule above says — ordered last so it always wins. Majors, replacements and rollbacks are operator decisions (DECISION-RIGHTS.md). Production `dependencies` are not listed here because no rule above ever allows them: a runtime dependency of any update type stays human-gated.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Renovate does NOT open security PRs. Dependabot owns security updates (org-enforced via DESIGN-DVW-org-config-1); this avoids duplicate security PRs. Renovate handles routine version updates only. See docs/ecosystem/DEPENDENCY-GOVERNANCE.md.
